scripts.install:all: pnpm -C backend install && pnpm -C frontend install && pnpm -C e2e install
scripts.build: pnpm -C backend build && pnpm -C frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:auth
scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/scripts e2e scripts --max-warnings 0 && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:version && pnpm check:env
